mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password_hash, display_name, status, email_verified_at, activated_at, token_version, must_change_password, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_user WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, email, password_hash, display_name, status, email_verified_at, activated_at, token_version, must_change_password, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET token_version=token_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND token_version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (email, password_hash, display_name, status, must_change_password, email_verified_at, activated_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{status}, #{mustChangePassword}, #{emailVerifiedAt}, #{activatedAt})
